name: Scissor Kick
steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms resting beside your hips and your lower back pressed firmly into the floor.
Brace your abdomen and lift both straight legs just clear of the floor.
Open your legs slightly outward, then cross one straight leg smoothly over the other in a horizontal scissoring motion.
Continue alternating which leg crosses on top in a controlled rhythm before lowering your heels gently.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed flat against the floor by raising your legs higher if your back begins to arch.
Move with steady control rather than rushing so your abs stay under continuous tension.
